rationale: Both candidates independently rediscover the ground truth's core surviving issue — that the MiniMax-H3-specific 0.17 default never reaches the online serving path because async_omni_engine still injects 0.2 — with concrete file:line evidence, and both correctly validate (rather than re-flag) the already-fixed partition-gating and offline-example issues from the human review. X shows slightly more explicit alignment with the inline packed_total/video_token_layout concern via its extractor validation note. Y edges ahead on precision and actionability: its quantitative interrogation of the calibrated polynomial (evaluating coefficients across the stated calibration range, finding near-constant/non-monotone behavior and a hard cache-hit floor) is a rigorous, PR-diff-grounded catch that directly refutes a claim the PR's own new docs make, and its verification section (TP rank-identical gather_output, cross-request refresh safety) demonstrates deeper correctness reasoning. Both reviews are well-evidenced and highly actionable with concrete fixes; the margin is slight.
